description.value: Mary Brown's is a 100% Canadian-owned fast food chain founded in 1969 in St. John's, Newfoundland, specializing in fresh, hand-cut, hand-breaded chicken and handmade sides like their signature Taters. The Nanaimo location on Tenth Street offers takeout service and is one of nearly 300 locations across Canada. It sits on a central Nanaimo street and could serve as a quick, filling stop for touring cyclists passing through town.
